About the author

James Pearson is part of the Visual Investigations team at Reuters, based in London. He was previously the European Cybersecurity Correspondent, the Reuters Bureau Chief in Vietnam and a correspondent with Reuters in Seoul, where he covered North and South Korea. Originally from Britain, Pearson studied Chinese and Korean at the School of Oriental & African Studies (SOAS), and East Asian Studies at the University of Cambridge. He is co-author of 'North Korea Confidential' with Daniel Tudor, a former Economist correspondent.
